info.title: Kinestop
info.author: SertAy
info.details:
❗Read the requirements at the bottom❗
--------------------------------------------------
Kinestop is an anti-motion sickness (kinetosis) overlay for the Nintendo Switch. It renders smooth 60 FPS floating motion cues synchronized with hardware sensors, eliminating nausea while playing games in moving vehicles (cars, buses, trains).

✨ Features:
• Prevents Motion Sickness: Syncs visual cues with physical motion.
• 100% Compatibility: Works in all games and the Switch Home Menu.
• Free Floating Mode: Dots drift naturally beyond screen edges.
• Visual Styles: 12 color themes, 6 placement patterns, size & opacity.
• Sensitivity: 10 adjustable levels (0.2x - 6.0x) with tremor filter.
• Zero Calibration: Calibrate center angle with a single click.
• Languages: English and Turkish language support.

⚠️Requirements

1) You MUST have nx-ovlloader and Ultrahand-Overlay installed.
2) Memory: Fully optimized for default 4MB overlay memory (no 8MB expansion required).

changelog: 2.0.0: Full 4MB Ultrahand memory optimization (eliminates crash risks); continuous 60 FPS hardware IMU tracking restored; smooth subpixel floating coordinates; Ultrahand signature header integration; clean UI refinements.
